deathSays.line: Movement — a thick-bodied rattlesnake, chevron bands, the tail a blur of dry sound.

Travel 2 tiles to forest floor.
— Under the canopy —
Saplings push up through last year's deadfall, racing each other for the light. The forest never stops trying.
The keeper of Thornfield's codex watches you copy the final page. "You're the first outsider to read it all," they say quietly. "Our dead wrote some of that. Carry it well."

Rich striped meat — cook it hard; this is the System's cut, not nature's. The fat burns long in a lamp. It's dead. The carcass is there on the ground — search the body if you want the meat. But you don't know this flesh. Clean it, test it cautiously, or ask someone who knows. And don't leave it long: meat rots where it lies.
Movement — a thick-bodied rattlesnake, chevron bands, the tail a blur of dry sound.

tableLines.line: The village feels it before they understand it: Haven isn't just Haven anymore. A woman, maybe 30s, with weathered hands speaks at Emberhold's table now — earned, not appointed. And the other fire is watching what Haven does FIRST.

⬢ SYSTEM: "One clarification, scholar: linking codices sharpens MY eyes. Ability slots grow from YOUR neural integration — 24/100, holding 2 slots (next at 40). Discover, practice, survive — let the interface learn you."
🎁 "OH! You can hold more now! We've been HOLDING this — take it, take it, take it!" (The System's gift awaits — choose an ability.)

With Haven grieving, Emberhold installs their own speaker at the table — but the bond is young, and they're still deciding what Haven is. The new speaker wants to talk before the tribute changes. Grief delays the verdict: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer.

✨ Ability gained: Fusion Reactor (L1). The System installs your fusion pellet — properly, inside you. You never need to eat again: the pellet covers your metabolism, and your strikes and abilities burn with a steady reactor fire (1.25x, always on). One reactor per world, and it never comes out: not unslotted, not un-taught, not surrendered. Death is the only uninstall. But the hunger is gone, and with it the joy: food gives you no morale, feasts give you no comfort, and your fire never burns hotter than this. A cold spot at every table.
